high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a clothing store. The individual is wearing a dark blue hoodie and has short, dark hair with a slight part on the side. They have small earrings in both ears and are holding a smartphone with both hands, which is positioned in front of them as they take the photo. The phone has a dual-camera setup on the back. The background reveals a well-lit, modern retail environment with white walls and ceiling lights.
